mutants.name: retry lends again
mutants.old:
else if s.seen.contains key then .ok []
        else if s.onLoan.length
mutants.new:
else if false then .ok []
        else if s.onLoan.length

mutants.name: closed card still lends
mutants.old:
| .checkOut key item, s =>
        if s.closed then .error .cardClosed
mutants.new:
| .checkOut key item, s =>
        if false then .error .cardClosed

mutants.name: return of a stranger's copy
mutants.old:
else if !s.onLoan.contains item then .error .notOnLoan
        else .ok [.checkedIn key item]
mutants.new:
else if false then .error .notOnLoan
        else .ok [.checkedIn key item]

mutants.name: closing a closed card publishes again
warning at the level
mutants.old: if onLoan > s.warnAt then [.limitWarning item onLoan]
mutants.new: if onLoan ≥ s.warnAt then [.limitWarning item onLoan]

mutants.name: fine compares backwards
mutants.old: else if i.now.day ≤ dueDay then .error (.notOverdue item)
mutants.new: else if i.now.day ≥ dueDay then .error (.notOverdue item)
